description: Source code for a wizard interface in OpenERP/Odoo, handling system setup and configuration steps including company info, profiles, and installation completion.

classes.name: wizard_base_setup
classes.description: Wizard interface class for system setup, managing configuration steps and form views.

methods.name: _get_profiles
methods.description: Retrieve available profile modules for selection.

methods.name: _get_company
methods.description: Fetch current company information for setup form.

methods.name: _get_all
methods.description: Retrieve list of records for a given model, used for selection fields.

methods.name: _get_states
methods.description: Get list of states for country selection.

methods.name: _get_countries
methods.description: Get list of countries for selection.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Get list of currencies for selection.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Update company and address information based on form input.

methods.name: _menu
methods.description: Set user menu actions to the setup menu.

methods.name: _next
methods.description: Determine next step in setup flow based on profile selection.

methods.name: _previous
methods.description: Determine previous step in setup flow.
